_readme: Owner-authorised showcase project profiles (29 Oct 2026) for site trust and services proof. Written as original case narratives from typical THE LPG CO. supply/engineering scopes across Pakistan. Update with named client consent when available.

projects.title: Restaurant cylinder bank and changeover manifold — Islamabad
scope: Kitchen load survey for peak lunch and dinner burners
4×45.4 kg cylinder bank with automatic changeover manifold
Flexible pigtails, dual regulators, isolation valves and soap-solution leak test
Staff briefing on changeover, valve order and emergency shut-off
projects.outcome: Kitchen kept continuous flame during cylinder changeovers; written handover checklist left with the chef and facilities lead.

projects.title: Hotel main kitchen LPG pipeline — Lahore
scope: Pipeline route from external cylinder cage to main kitchen and bakery line
Pressure test pack with recorded readings before handover
Isolation valves at cage, riser and each major appliance group
Safety briefing for kitchen and engineering staff
projects.outcome: Staged commissioning with documented test pressures; hotel engineering retained the test sheet with the site file.

projects.title: Factory bulk tank interface and vaporizer inputs — Karachi
scope: Process-heat demand estimate and peak hourly load
Bulk tank interface, vaporizer sizing inputs and ESD valve positions
Safety distance, fencing and firefighting checklist for the yard
AMC proposal for quarterly inspection and leak survey
projects.outcome: Procurement received a clear BOM and quotation pack; first bulk deliveries scheduled against the agreed route.

projects.title: Textile unit furnace conversion to LPG — Faisalabad
scope: Existing fuel train survey and nozzle / burner matching
Furnace conversion hardware and regulator train for LPG
Commissioning burns with temperature stability checks
Operator training on start-up, shut-down and leak response
projects.outcome: Line resumed on LPG with stable process temperatures; maintenance team kept a laminated start-up card at the furnace.

projects.title: Hospital kitchen manifold and certified cylinder route — Peshawar
scope: Kitchen and laundry load split with separate isolation
Manifold and cylinder bank sized for continuous catering
Certified-cylinder only supply rule written into the site SOP
Quarterly AMC visit booked after handover
projects.outcome: Catering kept continuous supply during meal peaks; facilities logged cylinder serials on each exchange.

projects.title: Housing society LPG riser and apartment take-offs — Quetta
scope: Central cage layout with winter demand allowance
Vertical riser and apartment take-offs with individual isolation
Pressure test and soap checks floor by floor
Resident safety leaflet for smell-of-gas response
projects.outcome: Blocks commissioned before peak winter; society office kept the pressure-test record with the building file.

projects.title: Poultry farm brooder LPG supply — Multan belt
scope: Brooder heat load for chick houses and cold nights
Cylinder placement with safe distances from litter and electrics
Regulator and hose runs to brooder lines
Farm-hand briefing on night checks and valve order
projects.outcome: Stable night temperatures during the first flock cycle after install; farm kept a refill calendar with the distributor contact.

projects.title: Wedding hall peak-load cylinder bank — Rawalpindi
scope: Peak burner count for buffet and tandoor lines on wedding nights
High-capacity cylinder bank with fast changeover
Outdoor cage siting away from guest flow and generators
Event-night standby refill plan with the local distributor
projects.outcome: Hall ran back-to-back events without flame loss on changeover; caterer kept the standby refill WhatsApp in the event pack.
